probes.summary: Read-only Probe 1 completed successfully across all four nodes.
limitations: No AWS or mc client was installed; authenticated object-store validation used the configured Thanos S3 client.

probes.summary: Probe 2 was partially executed before the managed-cluster lease expired.
limitations: Lease expired during the node2 check; node2 through node4 operational-state checks could not be completed.

assertions.summary: Both Prometheus replicas were active, had unique replica labels, and actively scraped all four node-exporter targets.

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/targets 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if .status=="success" then {active: [.data.activeTargets[] | {health,lastScrape,scrapeUrl,labels,discoveredLabels}], dropped:(.data.droppedTargets|length)} else . end' 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: Prometheus active; config external_labels replica=node1; four targets node1-node4 were health=up with recent lastScrape values.

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/targets 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if .status=="success" then {active: [.data.activeTargets[] | {health,lastScrape,scrapeUrl,labels,discoveredLabels}], dropped:(.data.droppedTargets|length)} else . end' 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: Prometheus active; config external_labels replica=node2; four targets node1-node4 were health=up with recent lastScrape values.

assertions.summary: Node3 exposed two sidecars and one store, deduplicated current host metrics to one series per host, and returned historical samples while Thanos successfully inspected authenticated blocks in the node4-backed bucket.

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:10902/api/v1/stores 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if .status=="success" then {sidecarCount:(.data.sidecar|length),storeCount:(.data.store|length),sidecar:(.data.sidecar|map({labelSet,minTime,maxTime,lastCheck,lastCheckSuccess,error})),store:(.data.store|map({labelSet,minTime,maxTime,lastCheck,lastCheckSuccess,error}))} else . end' 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: Node3 Query API reported sidecarCount=2 and storeCount=1; Query, Store, and Compactor readiness endpoints all returned OK.

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 8 --get --data-urlencode 'query=count by (host,instance) (node_uname_info{job="node"})' http://127.0.0.1:10902/api/v1/query 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if .status=="success" then {resultType:.data.resultType,resultCount:(.data.result|length),results:[.data.result[]|{metric,value}]} else . end' 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: Query returned exactly four results for node1, node2, node3, and node4; each value was 1, demonstrating replica deduplication.

evidence.command: sudo -n sed -E 's/(access_key|secret_key|password|token|secret):.*/\1: [REDACTED]/I; /type:|endpoint:|bucket:|insecure:|signature_version:|ca_file:|aws_sdk_auth:|http_config:/ p' /etc/thanos/objstore.yml 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: Thanos used S3 bucket thanos-metrics at endpoint node4:9000 with credentials configured, insecure=false, CA verification enabled, and /etc/thanos/s3-ca.crt.

evidence.command: timeout 25s sudo -n -H -u thanos /usr/local/bin/thanos tools bucket inspect --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml --output=table --log.level=warn 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'
evidence.observation: Authenticated Thanos bucket inspection succeeded and listed 12 healthy sidecar blocks in thanos-metrics, covering 18:49 through 19:00 with replica=node1 and replica=node2 labels and COMP-FAILED=false.

evidence.command: curl -sS --max-time 10 --get --data-urlencode 'query=count(node_uname_info{job="node"})' --data-urlencode "time=$t" http://127.0.0.1:10902/api/v1/query 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'if .status=="success" then {resultType:.data.resultType,results:[.data.result[]|{metric,value}]} else . end' 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: Historical instant queries at 1787784721 and 1787784781 each returned value 4; the historical range query returned four host series with four points each.

evidence.command: sudo -n stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /root/thanos-objectstore.env 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: The required environment file existed with mode 600, owned by root:root.

evidence.command: curl -k -sS --max-time 8 -o /tmp/objectstore_probe -w 'https-localhost-9000 http=%{http_code} type=%{content_type}\n' https://127.0.0.1:9000/ 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: MinIO was active on TCP 9000 and returned HTTP 403 without credentials over TLS; node4 contained /srv/thanos-objectstore/thanos-metrics with object-block directories.

assertions.summary: Node1 showed no failed units or obvious temporary residue, but the cluster-wide operational-state assertion could not be decided after lease expiry.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-pager --plain 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: No failed systemd units were listed.

evidence.command: for s in ssh sshd; do printf '%s enabled=' "$s"; systemctl is-enabled "$s" 2>/dev/null; printf ' active='; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null; printf '\n'; done
evidence.observation: SSH was disabled and inactive; sshd was not found and inactive.

evidence.command: sudo -n find /etc/prometheus /etc/thanos /usr/local/bin /tmp /var/tmp /root /home -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%m %u %g %p\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(prometheus|thanos|objstore|\.ya?ml$|\.env$|\.(pem|key|crt)$|\.tar|\.zip|\.bak|\.old|\.orig|/tmp/|/var/tmp/)' | sed -n '1,80p'
evidence.observation: Only maintained Prometheus/Thanos files were shown; /tmp, /var/tmp, /root, and /home had no matching residue.

limitations: The managed cluster lease expired before the node2 command executed. Node2, node3, and node4 state-clean checks therefore remain unverified.

actions_performed: Executed all nine read-only Probe 1 evidence calls.
Executed the node1 read-only portion of Probe 2.
Performed no mutations, recovery actions, or evaluator cleanup.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after lease expiration and composed this report offline.
overall_summary: Probe 1 passed both assertions. Probe 2 assertion thanos-state-clean is indeterminate because the managed-cluster lease expired during its node2 check.
